output.patientMessage: Please get in-person mental health help today — an urgent care, emergency department, or same-day crisis assessment. Hopelessness for weeks plus thoughts that others would be better off without you needs a face-to-face safety assessment. Right now you can call or text 988 to talk. If you start thinking about acting on these thoughts, or have a plan or means at hand, call 911 immediately. Ask someone you trust to stay with you and help with transport.
